searchText: Teku currently exposes V3 but always returns blinded version. VC currently uses V2 by default and V3 can be activated with a flag (supports fallback to V2 in case of 404). We haven't defined a deprecation plan ATM, a bit of coordination among clients makes sense.

excerpts.author: tbenr
excerpts.content:
Teku currently exposes V3 but always returns blinded version. VC currently uses V2 by default and V3 can be activated with a flag (supports fallback to V2 in case of 404).
We haven't defined a deprecation plan ATM, a bit of coordination among clients makes sense.
